request.name: Unbalanced spin load
request.overview: Spin speed is not reached with one bulky item in the drum.
request.observations: Drum tumbles, then slows and reports an unbalanced load.

matches.title: Washer will not spin; load imbalance reported
matches.resolution: The load was redistributed and the supervised spin test was repeated with a balanced load. The unit reached the expected spin stage.

matches.title: Suspension and load balance: service observation 003
matches.excerpt: Component: Suspension and load balance. Search terms: spin, unbalanced load, vibration, drum. Procedure: Check for an uneven or single bulky load and confirm the unit is level and stable. Repeat the spin observation with a balanced load. Refer persistent excessive movement or internal suspension checks to a qualified technician. Record sheet: page-specific observation 003; note model, program phase, displayed code, and test result. Safety: stop use if there is a leak, burning smell, or damaged cable. Electrical/internal work is for qualified service personnel only.

matches.title: Washer takes too long to complete spin
matches.resolution: The load was redistributed and the technician confirmed the washer was stable and level. The supervised spin test with a balanced load completed within the expected program behavior.

matches.title: Washer vibrates excessively during spin
matches.resolution: The technician confirmed the transit bolts had been removed, checked that all feet contacted the level floor, and repeated a balanced-load spin test. Vibration was within the service acceptance criteria.

suggestions.text: The load was redistributed and the supervised spin test was repeated with a balanced load. The unit reached the expected spin stage.

request.name: Door seal leak
request.overview: Water appears at the lower edge of the door during wash.
request.observations: No leak is seen at rear hoses; visible seal is being inspected.

matches.title: Washer leaks from the door during wash
matches.resolution: With the unit stopped, the technician inspected the door seal for trapped fabric and visible damage and checked that the door latched evenly. Debris was removed from the seal; the supervised leak test passed.

matches.title: Door seal and latch: service observation 004
matches.excerpt: Component: Door seal and latch. Search terms: door leak, seal, latch, water at door. Procedure: Stop the cycle and inspect the visible door seal for trapped fabric, debris, or damage. Confirm the door closes evenly. Do not operate with a damaged seal; record where and when leakage occurs. Record sheet: page-specific observation 004; note model, program phase, displayed code, and test result. Safety: stop use if there is a leak, burning smell, or damaged cable. Electrical/internal work is for qualified service personnel only.

matches.title: Washer has a musty odor after use
matches.resolution: The technician reviewed the model's drum-care instructions, cleaned the visible seal area, and ran the approved maintenance cycle. The odor was no longer present during follow-up.

matches.title: Washer door will not latch
matches.resolution: The technician inspected the door alignment and latch using the service procedure. The latch striker was adjusted and the interlock test passed.

matches.title: Door lock: service observation 007
matches.excerpt: Component: Door lock. Search terms: door locked, release, latch, cycle ended. Procedure: After the program ends, allow the normal release delay and confirm the drum is empty and drained. Record the lock indicator and exact sequence. Do not force the door; refer persistent lock faults to a qualified technician. Record sheet: page-specific observation 007; note model, program phase, displayed code, and test result. Safety: stop use if there is a leak, burning smell, or damaged cable. Electrical/internal work is for qualified service personnel only.
